opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt or excepted organisations; must have at least one year of audited or independently examined accounts; work must be based in the UK or UK Overseas Territories; cannot fund one‑off events, sponsorship, feasibility studies, mass fundraising appeals, overseas activities, endowment appeals, campaigning, rescue services, animal welfare, salaries for specific posts, etc.
opportunities.summary: Regular Grants support operating/core costs, capital projects, or specific project activities for eligible UK charities. Applications are accepted all year round with no set deadline.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt or excepted organisations; must have at least one year of audited or independently examined accounts; work must be based in the UK or UK Overseas Territories; for Major Grants, either annual income > £1m or total project/capital cost > £1m; same activity exclusions as Regular Grants (no events, sponsorship, overseas, etc.).
opportunities.summary: Major Grants support larger capital or project costs or core costs for eligible organisations with sufficient income or project size. Applications are accepted all year round with no set deadline and are considered at one of eight Board meetings per year.
